items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Vic Dickenson) does not speak in the provided context. The mention of Clarence Smith is made by the Interviewer, not the Interviewee.

ctx.x: I guess Edgar Battle had been in that band somewhere along the line.

Yeah, he had been in there. Then he got with a show called Puddinhead Jones or something like that. And they had a guy that played trumpet named Smitty, well-known... I mean, he was known around. Great first trumpet player. Clarence Smith.
